target_audience: Non-technical small-business owners (salons, restaurants, plumbers/HVAC, landscapers, cleaners, retail, online stores)
emotional_tone: Premium, modern, warm, trustworthy, human, clear, non-intimidating
archetype: ORGANIC & EARTHY / SWISS HYBRID (Warm Neutral + Deep Indigo Accent)

typography.h1_heading: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-extrabold tracking-tight leading-tight
typography.anti_patterns: Do not use generic raw Inter headers without weight contrast. Do not exceed text-6xl ceiling for headings.

layout_and_spacing.spacing_philosophy: Generous 2-3x padding (p-6, p-8, p-12) to ensure high scanability for busy users
layout_and_spacing.touch_targets: Minimum 48px height (h-12 or h-14) for all buttons and interactive choices
layout_and_spacing.mobile_rules: Mobile-first responsive (360px to 1440px+). All tables collapse to stacked card lists on viewports under 768px.
layout_and_spacing.bento_grid: Asymmetric grids with clear hierarchy: 1 primary hero box + 2 supporting context cards

elements: Header with logo, nav links (Marketplace, How It Works, Demo, Pricing), and 'Find My AI Tools' CTA button
Confident Hero section with high-impact headline, 1-line plain language value proposition, and interactive HTML/SVG tool fit preview card
Trust signals bar with real business types (Salons, HVAC, Restaurants, Cleaners) and clear outcome metrics
10-category SMB AI tools grid preview with tool counts and hours saved
Interactive 'How Idea Foundry Works' 3-step visualization
Start Free Evaluation CTA banner leading to /start
Step indicator progress bar (1 to 10) with clear plain text step titles
Large touch-friendly option buttons with descriptive icons and plain verbs
Back button and Skip/Next actions
Live estimated time remaining indicator (e.g., '2 mins left')
Google Sign-In simulated auth button with standard branding
Onboarding form fields: Full Name, Business Name, City/ZIP code, Optional Phone
Two explicitly UNTICKED consent checkboxes for data privacy and update alerts
Submit action: 'Complete Profile & View Recommendations'

Top 3 Recommendation Cards featuring: Fit label (Great Match, Good Fit, Evaluation Needed), One-line core reason, Why it fits box, Not for alert, Check first prerequisite, Price in $/mo or 'Not listed', Works with integrations, Hours-saved range (labeled 'rough estimate'), Unknowns callout box, Action buttons (Save, Compare, Set It Up)
Fit x Trust Custom SVG Quadrant Chart plotting evaluated tools on Match Quality vs Proof & Trust axes with clickable dots
Expandable 'Why these three?' methodology drawer/modal
Fallback alert banner when fewer than 3 tools meet minimum criteria

demo.design: Clearly labeled pre-populated sample datasets for Salon, Restaurant, Plumber
elements: Interactive business type selector (Salon & Spa, Restaurant & Café, Plumbing & HVAC)
Pre-loaded business profile header with simulated recommendation output
Interactive trial tool sandbox preview
Search input bar with instant keyword matching
10 Category chips (Customer Service, Scheduling, Marketing, Invoicing, Inventory, Lead Capture, Reviews, Operations, HR, Phone AI)
Filter bar: Price range, Free trial available, Works-with integration selector
Sort dropdown: Best Fit, Most Proven, Lowest Price, Highest Time Saved
Tool card grid with badges, price tags, hours saved, and 'View Breakdown' CTA
Show More / Pagination controls
Summary banner with plain language value pitch
Pricing breakdown in plain words (e.g., '$29/mo after 14-day free trial') plus 'Not listed' badge if hidden
Feature list with explicit 'Estimated' tags for AI-inferred capabilities
'How We Checked This Tool' verification box
User reviews & verifications list
Source citations with explicit marker: 'Written by the company or a competitor' vs independent evidence
Unknowns box listing missing information
SMB-Fit Warning box (e.g., 'Built for bigger businesses (50+ staff)') when applicable
Last-checked date stamp and public comments (first name only)
Side-by-side comparison matrix for 2 to 3 selected tools
Visual difference highlighting on key attributes (pricing, setup complexity, integrations, hours saved)
Plain-language Tradeoff Summary box explaining key compromises
Six fixed heading sections: 1. Preparation & Requirements, 2. Account Setup, 3. Integration & Sync, 4. First Test Run, 5. Staff Onboarding, 6. Maintenance & Safety
Interactive step-by-step completion checkboxes with persistence
'Was this guide helpful?' thumbs up/down feedback widget
AI Disclaimer banner: 'AI-generated setup assistance. Always double-check credentials and payment terms.'
Persistent grounded chat helper icon at bottom-right of all screens
Expandable conversation window with quick suggestion pills (e.g., 'What AI is best for a small salon?', 'How do I connect Square?')
Plain English responses tailored for busy non-technical business owners
Saved tools tabbed by status: Considering, Currently Using, Dropped
Activity & notifications feed regarding tool pricing changes or status updates
Business profile updates, location details, notification preferences
Tool submission form for AI vendors (Tool Name, Target Business Types, Pricing Model, Integrations, Verification Link)
Tool approval queue with Approve/Reject actions
Demo action button: 'Add a better tool and run alerts'
LLM Spend Dashboard: Today's spend, spend by task breakdown, cache hit rate metric, fallbacks counter, budget guard indicator

universal_guidelines: You have .js files (JavaScript / React standard JSX with Vite). Ensure all component code uses .js or .jsx extensions.

CRITICAL: Add explicit data-testid attributes to all interactive elements, buttons, inputs, filter options, cards, navigation links, and key indicators (e.g. data-testid='start-questionnaire-button', data-testid='recommendation-card-1', data-testid='fit-trust-quadrant-chart').
Header must have a solid or semi-solid glassmorphism background (backdrop-blur-md bg-stone-50/90 or bg-white/90). DO NOT use completely transparent header background.
Never show raw decimal scores like '0.87' or '8.4/10'. Convert scores into plain English terms: 'Great match', 'Good fit', 'Moderate fit', 'High trust', 'Verified by 12 SMBs'.
Pricing must be presented in clear dollars per month ($/mo) or 'Not listed' if unavailable.
Time savings must be shown as realistic ranges (e.g. '3 - 6 hrs/week') labeled clearly as 'rough estimate'.
Every tool detail page must include an 'Unknowns' box when information is missing or inferred.
All tables on mobile screens must collapse into vertical stacked cards for readability on small devices.
